agent.finish_summary: Fixed inverted safe/unsafe character branches in _make_quote_map() in boltons/urlutils.py, which was causing all 'safe' URL characters to be percent-encoded instead of left literal (and vice versa). This caused path/query/fragment quoting (quote_path_part, quote_query_part, quote_fragment_part, quote_userinfo_part) to produce fully percent-encoded garbage like 'E%61%73%70%78' instead of 'e-shops.aspx', breaking URL round-tripping, query param encoding, and IRI handling. Swapped the condition so safe_chars map to themselves and all other characters map to their %XX percent-encoding. Verified manually that URLs now round-trip correctly via to_text().
